title: Dashboard flexibility + container UX polish
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard supports persisted layout settings for column count and spacing.
Dashboard card catalog includes LLDP neighbors monitoring card.
Gateway dashboard card displays RTT, RTTsd, and Loss when probe metrics are available.
Container Management allows editing active instance host from the page.
Container Networks section is collapsed by default and expands on demand.
Backend and frontend validation gates pass for this slice.
assumptions: Gateway probe metrics are best-effort and may be unavailable on some VyOS builds without failing the API/card.
Card-level width menus remain 1-3 columns for now, while grid layout supports 2-4 columns globally.
Existing unrelated working tree changes remain untouched.

tasks.notes: Added optional gateway probe metrics and parser coverage without changing existing endpoint contract shape for callers.
Implemented dashboard layout settings, LLDP card, gateway metrics display, container instance-host editing, and collapsed network management UX.
Ran backend pytest and frontend typecheck/lint/build/runtime+UI smoke gates.
Manual review in progress for UX/operational behavior on live instance before final commit.
